def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Rotate clockwise.
    out = [[grid[h - 1 - c][r] for c in range(h)] for r in range(w)]

    # The 1s and 9s are overlays/background; fill them from the closest
    # non-overlay colored cell.
    sources = [(r, c, out[r][c]) for r in range(w) for c in range(h)
               if out[r][c] not in (1, 9)]
    result = [row[:] for row in out]
    for r in range(w):
        for c in range(h):
            if out[r][c] in (1, 9) and sources:
                _, _, color = min(sources, key=lambda p: (
                    abs(p[0] - r) + abs(p[1] - c), p[0], p[1]))
                result[r][c] = color
    return result
